keyword.zh: 电动60和电动80混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动60和电动80混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Electric 60 prints three stone rows and fine-stone 200 m / 600 m. Electric 80 prints one distance pair, 900 m / 300 m, at 60 m³/h.
description.zh: 电动60印三行石子距离，细石为 200 m / 600 m。电动80只印一组距离 900 m / 300 m，产量 60 m³/h。

h1.zh: 电动60和电动80混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 60 and Electric 80 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa and three stone-distance rows, with fine stone at 200 m / 600 m. Electric 80 prints 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, one pair at 900 m / 300 m, and aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). The 900 m figure is not a fourth row on the Electric 60 page.
directAnswer.zh: 电动60和电动80是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa 和三行石子距离，细石为 200 m / 600 m。电动80印 110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、一组 900 m / 300 m，骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。900 m 不是电动60页面上的第四行。

heading.en: Where Electric 60 and Electric 80 print different values
heading.zh: 电动60和电动80哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: Electric 60 prints 90 kW; Electric 80 prints 110 kW. Theoretical output: Electric 60 prints 40 m³/h; Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 60 prints 35 MPa; Electric 80 prints 40 MPa. Hydraulic pump: Electric 60 prints Kawasaki double pump 112; Electric 80 prints Kawasaki 140 double pump. Main unit weight: Electric 60 prints 3300 kg; Electric 80 prints 6000 kg. The same printed value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.7 m³ on both pages; Dimensions is 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动60印 90 kW；电动80印 110 kW。理论输送量：电动60印 40 m³/h；电动80印 60 m³/h。最大出口压力：电动60印 35 MPa；电动80印 40 MPa。液压泵：电动60印 Kawasaki double pump 112；电动80印 Kawasaki 140 double pump。整机重量：电动60印 3300 kg；电动80印 6000 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.7 m³；外形尺寸两边都是 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 60 prints cells that Electric 80 does not: Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 200 m / 600 m; 13 mm stone (H / V) 150 m / 450 m; 24 mm stone (H / V) 100 m / 300 m. Electric 80 prints cells that Electric 60 does not: Model line Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110; Pumping distance (H / V) 900 m / 300 m; Max. aggregate size 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动60有、电动80没有的行：细石输送（水平/垂直） 200 m / 600 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 150 m / 450 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m。电动80有、电动60没有的行：型号行 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110；输送距离（水平/垂直） 900 m / 300 m；最大骨料粒径 24 mm (≤ 2 cm)。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: One page splits distance by stone size. The other prints a single horizontal and vertical pair. Open /en/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/ for Electric 60 and /en/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/ for Electric 80. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 一页按石子粒径拆开距离，另一页只印一组水平和垂直距离。看电动60请打开 /zh/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/，看电动80请打开 /zh/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 60 print the same motor power as Electric 80?
question.zh: 电动60和电动80的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 60 prints 90 kW. Electric 80 prints 110 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动60印 90 kW。电动80印 110 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 60 print the same theoretical output as Electric 80?
question.zh: 电动60和电动80的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 60 prints 40 m³/h. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动60印 40 m³/h。电动80印 60 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 60 print the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 80?
question.zh: 电动60和电动80的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 60 prints 35 MPa. Electric 80 prints 40 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动60印 35 MPa。电动80印 40 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is fine-stone conveying (h / v) missing on Electric 80?
question.zh: 为什么电动80没有细石输送（水平/垂直）？

answer.en: The Electric 80 page does not print that label. Electric 60 prints 200 m / 600 m. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动80这一页没有印这个标题。电动60印的是 200 m / 600 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
